title: Using kotlin enums as resteasy reactive jackson params fails
body:
## Describe the bug
I am unable to use kotlin enums as query params with resteasy reactive jackson
I found this, but the author didn't make a bug report.
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/67063480/using-enums-as-query-params-in-resteasy-reactive-quarkus

### Expected behavior
Usable enum params like with reseasy jackson without reactive.

### Actual behavior
I am forced to use the resteasy jackson which is uname to convert localdate param values. (Converter exists only in reactive)


## To Reproduce
[reactive-jackson-query-params-kotlin-enum.tar.gz](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/6489292/reactive-jackson-query-params-kotlin-enum.tar.gz)

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. `./gradlew quarkusDev`
